rationale: Fintech market map: mine once for the CZ payments/fintech actor list, not a recurring regulatory signal.
Legal publisher tracking amendment effective dates, but redundant against official e-Sbirka and licensing unclear.
Official consolidated CZ statute portal with effective dates — the authoritative backbone for deadline series.
One-off documentation page announcing the e-Sbirka open API; mine once to wire machine-readable ingestion.
National DCAT open-data catalogue; standalone discovery layer for new legal/registry datasets.
VeKLEP legislative pipeline: earliest structured signal of draft banking/payments rules and consultation deadlines.
Static process documentation needed to interpret VeKLEP stages; reference artifact, not a signal producer.
CNB archive of repealed notices; valuable for history but a section of the cnb.cz legislativa tree already monitored.
Single regulator-hosted act PDF; an evidence snapshot, not a monitorable feed.
Parliament bulk open data and snemovni tisky give the authoritative stage/date chain before Sbirka publication.
National .cz web archive; standalone fallback for regulator pages lost in the .gov.cz migration.
Wayback CDX API enables programmatic recovery and dated proof of rotted CZ regulator URLs.
gov.cz service-catalogue record for e-Sbirka; adds nothing standalone beyond the portal itself.
Operator page where breaking changes to the e-Sbirka publication/API channel are announced.
MF consultation archive carries response deadlines and CZ national discretions for EU financial-market files.
Third-party consolidated Sbirka with useful amendment-pair diffs, but URL check failed and terms unclear.
CNB archive subsection of the supervision publications tree; covered by monitoring the parent hub.
Single dated news item announcing one edition of the supervision report; evidence, not a recurring source.
Flagship twice-yearly Financial Stability Report hub; failed URL check is soft, re-verify liveness.
EN index of the same financial-stability publication family as the CZ hub; useful mirror, not standalone.
CCyB page states the rate and its explicit 'with effect from' date — core dated requirement for the deadline series.
LTV/DTI/DSTI caps with activation dates; directly binding on bank mortgage lending systems.
One supervisory recommendation announcement; a dated soft-law artifact rather than a producing source.
Systemic risk buffer settings with application dates; changes bank capital planning materially.
O-SII designation list with institution-level buffer rates and effective dates.
Conservation buffer page rarely changes; sibling of the macroprudential-policy hub already tracked.
